entries.reason: absent, decided by the class's own method list in the release and not by what a header redeclares. ARPlaneAnchor's own instance list in ARKitCore of the arm64e shared cache of iOS 16.0 is thirty-three twelve-byte entries and contains neither -initWithName:transform: nor its sibling; the 16.4 headers mark both NS_UNAVAILABLE (ARPlaneAnchor.h:118-119), and an NS_UNAVAILABLE redeclaration obliges the port to nothing - what is measured is the metadata, not the header. The controls of that read: the list resolves and prints every selector it holds, so a read that found nothing would print nothing, and the selectors this class does have are there (-initWithAnchor:, -encodeWithCoder:, -initWithCoder: for ARPlaneAnchor; -referenceImage, -copyWithTrackedState:, -initWithAnchor: for ARImageAnchor). Both classes are absent from the class lists of both armv7 caches this port's bands run on (0 of 11378 class names of 6.1.3 and 0 of 7187 of 4.3 begin AR), so the release does not have them either and no band loses anything by their absence
